fields.name: consumed
docs: Lifetime expenditure; repayment has no Registry entrypoint.

fields.name: revision
docs: Positive revision of the owner-approved allowance policy.

fields.name: source
docs: Exact admitted funding source for this first issuer-backed profile.

fields.name: owner
docs: This first profile has one Ed25519 owner. Other governance profiles
require distinct handlers and cannot be selected by this field.

types.name: RepaymentExecution
docs: Core supplies authenticated live obligation/title/route facts and the actual
allocation after accrual. Only Core's fixed consumer PDA can consume a grant.

types.name: RepaymentPermissionTerms
docs: Immutable owner-granted scope. An exact approval sets the three exact fields
and permits one payment; a standing grant sets them to zero. A fresh grant is
required to change any route, limit, executor or authority generation.

types.name: SpendingExecution
docs: Only Core's Registry-consumer PDA may supply these authenticated effects.
The request commits the quoted minimum; amount_out is the observed result.

fields.name: minimum_output_numerator
docs: Smallest accepted output/input rate, in the respective token atoms.
Every swap must request and receive at least ceil(input * n / d).

fields.name: expected_revision
docs: Optimistic concurrency guard, excluded from the stable business identity.
Exact retries retrieve the prior result even after the claim advances.
